# Vendored third-party code (browser host UI only)

Generated by `scripts/vendor-dicebear.mjs`. The core, worlds and engine never import these files (AGENTS.md).

| File | Library | Version | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dicebear-core.mjs` | @dicebear/core (one bundled ES module) | 10.7.0 | https://github.com/dicebear/dicebear | MIT |

## DiceBear style definitions (from @dicebear/styles 10.6.0)

Each definition is copied unchanged to `dicebear-styles/<style>.json`. Only CC0 styles are used, so no attribution is required; the creator is credited anyway.

| File | Style | Creator | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dicebear-styles/voxel-bot.json` | voxel-bot | DiceBear | CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) |
| `dicebear-styles/open-peeps.json` | open-peeps | Pablo Stanley | CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) |
| `dicebear-styles/moods.json` | moods | DiceBear | CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) |

The definitions are also the source of the `ui.avatar` legend and lexicon (`scripts/legend-from-dicebear.mjs`).
